meta.title: How Binary Search Works & Everyday Uses | Superfast Algorithm Explained
meta.description: Ever wondered how your phone finds a contact instantly or how banking databases search 100 Crore accounts in milliseconds? Meet Binary Search (बाइनरी सर्च)—the ultimate divide-and-conquer algorithm that halves the search space at every step!
facts_to_verify: Best case time complexity: O(1) when target is at the midpoint
Worst case time complexity: O(log2 N)
misconceptions: Binary search works on any list (debunk: strictly requires sorted data)
Linear search is useless (debunk: linear search is required for unsorted or small dynamic lists)
meta.analogy: Opening a dictionary directly in the middle (Page 500) and cutting out half the book at every single step

scenes.title: THE 1,000-PAGE DICTIONARY
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of THE 1,000-PAGE DICTIONARY.
scenes.narration: अगर आपको एक हज़ार पन्नों की डिक्शनरी में शब्द ढूँढना हो, तो क्या आप पहला पन्ना खोलते हैं? कभी नहीं! आप सीधे बीच से किताब खोलते हैं। यही मानवीय आदत कंप्यूटर साइंस का सुपरफास्ट एल्गोरिदम है—बाइनरी सर्च!
